column1: # Wild cherry (Prunus avium; Ronald, 11-05, via Planner: "Yes, add wild cherry"): groves in the old-growth forest and the temperate forests, pink in spring (Bliss's cherry groves). Its leaves are drawn in their own colours (vitals::wild::OWN_COLOURS), both the bloom and the summer green.

column3: log_cherry|log|Wild cherry bark: smooth glossy reddish mahogany-brown bark (#3e2420 #5a3028 #74403a #8a5248 #a06a5c) in bands that wrap AROUND the trunk, with rows of pale grey-tan lenticels (#b8a08a #9a8270) as horizontal dashes 3-6 px long running left to right, a few bands peeling in thin horizontal curls, fine dark lines between the bands, no deep vertical grooves, seamless on all four edges
column4: log_cherry_top|end|Wild cherry log cut end: warm reddish-pink-brown heartwood (#8a4a34 #a8603e #c07a52 #d4966a) with 4-5 fine growth rings, a paler cream sapwood ring (#dcc0a0) round it, a small darker centre, a 2 px rim of glossy red-brown bark (#5a3028)
column5: planks_cherry|built|Cherry wood planks: four boards of warm reddish-brown cherry wood (#4a2a20 #6e3e2c #8a5038 #a2644a #b87a5a), fine straight grain, a few small dark flecks, a little richer and redder than oak
column6: branch_cherry|log|Young wild cherry branch bark: the same glossy red-brown bark as the cherry log but younger, smoother and a shade lighter (#5a3028 #6e3c30 #84503e #9a644e #b07a62), small pale lenticel dashes (#b8a08a) 2-4 px long running ACROSS the square (left to right), scattered about 3 px apart, no deep fissures, evenly textured so any narrow vertical strip of it (8 or 4 px) reads as cherry bark, seamless on all four edges

column3: leaves_cherry_bloom|fleaves|A wild cherry crown in full spring blossom: the square packed with clusters of soft pink five-petalled blossoms 3-5 px across (#c86c90 #e08cac #f2b0c8 #fad4e2, a few near-white petals #fff0f4), each with a tiny darker pink centre, in clusters of three to five on short stalks, a few small young bronze-green leaves (#6a7a3a #8a9a4a) among them, thin dark red-brown twigs (#4a2a24), gaps of flat solid magenta covering 15-25% of the tile, tileable
column4: leaves_cherry|fleaves|Wild cherry foliage in summer: oval pointed leaves 4-6 px with finely toothed edges, hanging slightly down, in a deep mid green (#2e5a24 #3e6e2c #56883a #6e9e48), a few turned to show paler undersides (#8aae68), thin red leaf stalks (#7a3a2c) and red-brown twigs (#4a2a24), no flowers, gaps of flat solid magenta covering 20-30% of the tile, tileable
column5: sapling_cherry|plant|A young wild cherry sapling: a thin glossy red-brown stem (#5a3028 #84503e) with tiny pale horizontal lenticel ticks, three or four oval pointed toothed green leaves (#3e6e2c #56883a #6e9e48) drooping on short red stalks, and one small cluster of three soft pink blossoms (#e08cac #f2b0c8) near the top, about 22 px tall

column1: # The first bloom was 41% open against the summer leaves' 32%: redrawn denser so the season switch doesn't thin the crown (the dogwood's lesson). BLOCK_LIKE=leaves_ipe_bloom,leaves_dogwood

column3: leaves_cherry_bloom_b|fleaves|A wild cherry crown in full spring blossom, DENSE: the whole square packed with overlapping clusters of soft pink five-petalled blossoms 4-6 px across (#c86c90 #e08cac #f2b0c8 #fad4e2, a few near-white petals #fff0f4), each with a tiny darker pink centre, clusters touching each other, a few small young bronze-green leaves (#6a7a3a #8a9a4a) and short dark red-brown twigs (#4a2a24) showing between them, only small gaps of flat solid magenta covering 15-20% of the tile, tileable
column4: leaves_cherry_bloom_c|fleaves|A wild cherry crown in full spring blossom seen from a little way off: big rounded puffs of pink blossom (#c86c90 #e08cac #f2b0c8 #fad4e2 #fff0f4) made of many small five-petalled flowers 3-4 px, the puffs 8-12 px across and touching, darker pink shade on their lower right, a few dark red-brown twigs (#4a2a24) and bronze-green leaflets (#6a7a3a) between, small gaps of flat solid magenta covering 15-20% of the tile, tileable

column1: # The stripped twin (after row a's planks and end were put in the game). BLOCK_LIKE=planks_cherry,log_cherry_top,log_dogwood_stripped

column3: log_cherry_stripped|log|Stripped wild cherry log side: the bark taken off, smooth bare cherry wood in exactly the colour of the attached cherry planks and log top (warm reddish-pink-brown heartwood, the inner wood, not the bark), long fine vertical grain lines running the full height, faint darker growth streaks and one or two small knots, a little darker and less even than the planks, no boards, no seams, seamless top to bottom
column4: log_cherry_stripped_top|end|Stripped wild cherry log end: the same cross-section as the attached cherry log top (reddish heartwood rings, the paler cream sapwood ring) but with no bark rim, the sapwood running to the edge, bevelled
